mapper.select: SELECT id, loan_number, user_id, loan_type, principal_amount, interest_rate, duration_months, monthly_emi, status, remaining_amount, applied_at FROM loans WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, loan_number, user_id, loan_type, principal_amount, interest_rate, duration_months, monthly_emi, status, remaining_amount, applied_at FROM loans WHERE loan_number = #{loanNumber}

SELECT id, loan_number, user_id, loan_type, principal_amount, interest_rate, duration_months, monthly_emi, status, remaining_amount, applied_at FROM loans WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY applied_at DESC

SELECT id, loan_number, user_id, loan_type, principal_amount, interest_rate, duration_months, monthly_emi, status, remaining_amount, applied_at FROM loans WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY applied_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loans (loan_number, user_id, loan_type, principal_amount, interest_rate, duration_months, monthly_emi, status, remaining_amount) VALUES (#{loanNumber}, #{userId}, #{loanType}, #{principalAmount}, #{interestRate}, #{durationMonths}, #{monthlyEmi}, #{status}, #{remainingAmount})
